private_material: Exact numerical resolution, thresholds and scenario answers remain in the facilitator guide and engine; purchased player handouts reveal qualitative conditions.

checks.author_edits_preserved: Latest native introductions, removed briefs title and split facilitator title preserved; scoped gameplay revisions applied.
checks.component_transfer: Current assets, orders and authority rewritten for v0.4; tracks and descriptions preserved.
checks.phase_integration: Recording instructions and defaults occur in the phase where used; no separate Decision sheets section.
checks.native_readback: All four documents read back and captured after edits.
checks.faction_access: Teammates only; Ascendant visits after one irrevocable prophecy/NONE choice. No current plans disclosed before choice.
checks.vision_window: Versioned v0.4 cards use Lantern civilian transport, all relief vessels and Grey Petrel military transport. Vetoes, loss and commitments can limit useful choices.
checks.council_tables: Players stay at their own council. GN records Navigation allocations; JS records Security allocations. The Ascendant does not choose Navigation orders from Security.
checks.player_information: Qualitative assets/orders/visions; all three tracks described at 0–4. Exact operation effects moved to facilitator procedure. Requirements, authority, duties and settlement stay public.
checks.current_weights: New games follow the native Guild rule: intact Wayfarer + surviving Lantern + floor(Beacon/2). Legacy replays retain prior weights.
checks.asset_cards: Card positions and two home faces replace paper faction sheets. Orders require public traits from assets.py. Existing eligibility and outcomes unchanged; named duties and visions retained.
checks.opening_sequence: News chosen before negotiations; free/veto/articles before factions; commitments apply that round; old authority and previous-round contributions set vetoes; direct final Ceremony. News is fiction, exact triggers concealed.
checks.other_orders: Faction Orders terminology; Other at factions and councils; facilitator rules against printed orders, no efficiency advantage or coordination bypass.

limitations: Editorial and mechanical checks, not a new human or agent playtest. Existing authority sets vetoes before article changes; two rounds do not exercise newly enacted articles’ following-month vetoes. Historical evidence retains its ruleset.
setting_change: Sorenne’s Fall and the Sorenne Flag replace generic civilian and remnant descriptions. Stability retains the former Communities arithmetic; it measures supply and civil services, not political loyalty.
